chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Turin, 2018. Real Madrid attack down the right. Ronaldo waits in the box, back to goal. Carvajal crosses. Ronaldo flies up... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. His eyes never leave the ball. He jumps early, lies flat in the air, and scissors his legs.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: Buffon can't move. It's two-nil, and even the Juventus fans stand up and clap!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Beginners: practise on soft ground, with a coach. The secret is timing and body shape. Watch the ball, jump early, and land safely on your hands and back.
